description: This Java class 'ModifyResource' defines a command to modify a Resource within a Policy in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, manipulating headers, and serializing to JSON. It also references related policy and resource classes and interfaces.

classes.name: ModifyResource
classes.description: A command class that modifies a Resource within a Policy, providing serialization, deserialization, and creation methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a ModifyResource command instance with typed PolicyId.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static method to deserialize a ModifyResource command from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the Label identifying the PolicyEntry to modify.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Returns the Resource object to be modified.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId of the Policy that contains the Resource.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Serializes the Resource to JSON according to schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Provides the JSON pointer path to target the resource within the Policy structure.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the command data to a JSON object builder, respecting schema version and predicate filtering.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Determines the category of the command, here 'MODIFY'.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified Ditto headers.
